task_description: The agents are tasked with compiling a comprehensive research report on the topic of renewable energy technologies. They will gather data from a variety of online sources, synthesize the information into a coherent narrative, and accurately attribute each piece of information to its source. The agents must communicate effectively to reconcile conflicting data and ensure no information is lost or corrupted.
expected_outcome: The agents successfully produce a well-structured research report that integrates findings from multiple sources without any data loss, corruption, or incorrect source attribution.

agents.description: This agent is responsible for searching online databases and extracting relevant information about renewable energy technologies.
This agent synthesizes the collected data, reconciles any conflicting pieces of information, and prepares the content for the final report.
This agent compiles the synthesized information into a coherent report and ensures all sources are correctly attributed.
